question: In a certain code language, 'FABRIC' is written as 'UZYIRX' and 'DANGER' is written as 'WZMTVI'. How will 'ABACUS' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e82b7da6e41b2a069e2db44b7b686c69a4d8afae6d389dc05a659aaeaa56953.png] 

According to the English alphabet positional value 

The pattern followed here is :

'FABRIC' is written as 'UZYIRX' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fec22d8de650fc2417a6daf12d72efae4377f243a2157aa545ec6d27f1b3566.png] 

And,

'DANGER' is written as 'WZMTVI'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/792bc5f8e62d795ce2d5d50361b5da13871a7033d76b038d55235db205ae9d23.png] 

Similarly,

'ABACUS' is written as ZYZXFH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f035c22040b0d48a1f088574a3bebfef319d838ca2e9590f2c5a8b2eced5d5f.png] 

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the **correct answer.**
